_doc: A few files exceed the 400-line ceiling for structural reasons. The check still hard-fails on growth past the recorded baseline so each file can't drift further.

exempt._reason: Search Web Worker — title index, inverted/prefix builders, scoring, postMessage protocol, the origin-validating init guard, and the manifest-filename allowlist all in a single file because Web Workers can't share scope across module boundaries without bundler support. The guards genuinely belong here: they cannot be imported, so this file is the only place they can live. Pinned to 423.

DocsDatabase is the thin delegation facade over the per-domain repos — it accretes one-line pass-throughs as features land (v25 added the chunk-vector tier; §10(B) added hasBodyIndex + resetSemanticCountCaches). Statements live in repos/*; splitting the facade itself would only scatter the delegation map. Logic with a body of its own does NOT belong here: the root-by-id memo lives in repos/roots.js and page tombstoning in tombstones.js. Pinned to 400.
